nodes.name: Gmail Trigger
nodes.notes: Filters on the subject line students are told to use. Distinct from the CV workflow's "CV Application" filter, so the two never pick up each other's mail.

nodes.name: Review (FastAPI)
nodes.notes: No text-extraction node before this one, unlike the CV workflow. The backend hashes the exact bytes it received and prints those hashes on the certificate, and it refuses scans that carry no extractable text — extracting here would throw away both. All three attachments go up under the same field name; the backend reads each document to decide which is which, so their order does not matter. neverError is set because a package held for clarification is a normal 201 outcome, and because a genuine 5xx should still reach the reply node rather than leave the student with no answer. If PDFSIGN_API_SECRET_KEY is set on the backend, add Authentication → Generic → Header Auth with name 'Authorization' and value 'Bearer <key>'.

nodes.name: Reply to Student
nodes.notes: One node for every outcome. The backend composes the subject and body from the findings — drafted by the LLM when available, from templates when not — so there is no branching here, and no second place where the wording of a request can drift out of sync with the reason for it.

nodes.name: Waiting on a coordinator?
nodes.notes: Only 'approved' and 'pending' need a person. A package held for clarification or rejected is already back with the student.

parameters.subject: =Internship completion to review: {{ $json.student_name }} ({{ $json.status }})

nodes.name: Notify Coordinator
nodes.notes: The workflow stops here. Signing is a deliberate action in the dashboard against POST /reports/by-id/{id}/sign; a node that called it automatically would remove the only human from the process and leave the university issuing completion certificates on the strength of a regex over a PDF.
